execution: Prepared only; the package query was not run.

interpretation.selection: The positional package ID selects exactly Microsoft.Azure.SignalR. --tfm net8.0 selects its net8.0 implementation libraries. The library-literal facet downloads the package and searches decoded string-literal uses in those libraries.
interpretation.matching: The operand https:// is matched as an ordinal substring of each decoded string-literal use. It is not a whole-string equality test.
interpretation.normalization: Preserve the operand exactly, including whitespace, newlines, and case; no normalization occurs.
interpretation.repeated_values: Identical repeated library-literal values collapse to one distinct operand; distinct values are incompatible.
interpretation.length_bounds: The operand must contain 1 through 1024 UTF-16 code units, inclusive.
interpretation.six_hundred_astral_characters: No. Each astral character occupies two UTF-16 code units, so 600 occupy 1200 and exceed the 1024-unit maximum.
interpretation.empty_values: The empty listed-values array alone does not imply arbitrary acceptance. The facet's explicit input rule accepts any decoded UTF-16 text within its constraints.
interpretation.candidate_limit: A query using library-literal admits at most five package candidates; an exact package ID admits at most one.

scope.uncertainty: No package content or result was inspected, so whether this package actually contains a matching literal is unknown. The explanation establishes the query contract, not a match result.
